statement: A fix for a detector miss must be paired with a control proving it adds no false credit: narrowing an exclusion widens what gets credited. Occurrence 2026-09-23, cejel PR #358 at 87aa4d1: to stop a URL's `//` hiding a same-line `app.use(`, A3's reachability stripper was narrowed from `//`-to-end-of-line to whole `//` lines. That made a trailing comment after code (`x = 1; // app.use(errorHandler);`) count as code, crediting a never-registered handler stub under the default rubric, which main does not credit. The new fixture covered only the credit side, so CI stayed green. Fixed in 6c69204 with a `(?<!:)` lookbehind and control D5. Rule: when relaxing an exclusion, add the nearest shape it existed to reject and require it red against the relaxed version.
